input.comment: [Playbook] We deleted the sole-and-exclusive provider commitment in clause 2.2 because our playbook does not permit exclusivity or sole-supplier obligations on us, and the clause conflicts with clause 2.1 (no minimum or purchase commitment). If Silverline needs volume assurance, we can discuss a non-exclusive statement or exclusivity limited to a defined product category for 12 months that ends automatically on any service-level or delivery failure.
input.summary: Delete exclusivity obligation making Vendor Customer's sole and exclusive provider.
